# Frontend Checklist: Interacción fluida del listado de tareas

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements quality covering HU-15 (completar sin recarga) and HU-16 (reordenar por arrastre) — completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the spec/plan before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [contracts/order-contracts.md](../contracts/order-contracts.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are provisional vs. definitive visual-state requirements defined for the HU-15 optimistic update (how the row looks before confirmation vs. after)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the subir/bajar button requirements fully specified (ordering semantics, persistence path reuse, focus management)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are error-message content requirements defined (placement, duration, wording criteria, non-technical examples)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 - Is "inmediatamente después de soltar" quantified with a specific persistence-initiation criterion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is "mensaje de error comprensible" clarified with specific wording or content criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is "vista filtrada actual" enumerated with the exact set of views that keep independent order? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "sin recargar la página completa" defined with what partial updates are allowed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are valid vs. invalid drop positions defined for drag-and-drop (cancel outside, single-item list)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 - Are direct-jump transition requirements consistent between the 2026-10-11 clarification and FR-001/FR-005 reuse of the existing status contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are backend-change requirements consistent between the spec "ningún endpoint nuevo, solo campo de orden" and the plan/contracts introducing POST /tasks/reorder? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are revert requirements consistent between HU-15 failure handling and HU-16 failure handling? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are per-view ordering requirements consistent across FR-008, FR-011, and the per-view renumbering rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 - Can SC-001 "95% sin recarga en condiciones normales de red" be objectively measured (network definition, attempt sample)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK014 - Can SC-004 "tiempo percibido inferior a 2 segundos" be objectively measured (start/end observation points, measurement method)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 - Can SC-005 "90% de usuarios sin ayuda adicional" be objectively verified (cohort definition, task protocol)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 - Can "nunca estado falso confirmado" be objectively verified (what counts as stable vs. provisional display)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-002]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 - Are rapid double-action requirements defined for HU-15 (single confirmed change prevailing, control disabled until response)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are recovery requirements defined after a failed reorder (is retry allowed, is the prior confirmed order restorable)? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are requirements defined for single-task and empty filtered views as specified no-ops without error? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are keyboard and screen-reader interaction requirements specified beyond button existence (focus order, announcements)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-015]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are concurrent-edit requirements addressed (same user in two tabs, rapid successive reorders)? [Coverage, Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for completing an already-completed, deleted, or unauthorized task (idempotency, messaging)? [Coverage, Spec §US1-Scenario-4, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are new-task placement requirements complete when a reorder is in flight (deterministic end position preserved)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 - Are audit requirements for reorder quantified (one record per persistence, action name, entity_id semantics for a batch)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are server-side authorization requirements specified for reorder batches (owner vs. assignee, partial-ownership rejection)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are safe-degradation requirements testable without extended browser features (which features, which base flow)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 - Is the assumption that increments 1–4 contracts are implemented and documented validated and versioned? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the initial deterministic order for pre-existing tasks defined, or explicitly deferred with an owner and decision point? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK010 is the highest-risk consistency item: spec text vs. plan/contracts deviation on the new reorder endpoint must be resolved in requirements before implementation
- Add comments or findings inline
